SRV6_MY_LOCATOR_INVALID_FUNC_LEN.desc: A locator configured with invalid func_len

SRV6_MY_LOCATOR_INVALID_VRF.desc: A locator configured with an invalid VRF name

SRV6_MY_SID_INVALID_LOCATOR.desc: A SID configured with invalid locator identifier

SRV6_MY_SID_INVALID_IP_PREFIX.desc: A SID configured with invalid IPv6 address

SRV6_MY_SID_INVALID_ACTION.desc: A SID with action uA but missing interface (must constraint)
eStr: interface is mandatory when action is 'uA'

SRV6_MY_SID_UA_MISSING_INTERFACE.desc: A SID configured with action uA but missing interface
eStr: interface is mandatory when action is 'uA'

SRV6_MY_SID_UA_MISSING_ADJ.desc: Valid config with action uA (adj is optional)

SRV6_MY_SID_UA_MISSING_BOTH.desc: A SID configured with action uA but missing both interface and adj
eStr: interface is mandatory when action is 'uA'

SRV6_MY_SID_ADJ_INVALID_ACTION.desc: A SID with adj set but action is not uA
eStr: adj is only applicable when action is 'uA'
SRV6_MY_SID_ADJ_INVALID_ACTION.desc: A SID with adj set but an action that is neither uA nor End.X related
eStr: adj is applicable only for 'uA', 'End.X' related actions

SRV6_MY_LOCATOR_FUNC_LEN_ABOVE_20.desc: Locator whose lengths sum to 128 but func_len is 32, above the FRR ceiling of 20
eStr: func_len exceeds the supported maximum of 20

SRV6_MY_LOCATOR_FUNC_LEN_AT_MAXIMUM.desc: Locator with func_len 20 and the remaining bits in arg_len, summing to exactly 128

SRV6_MY_LOCATOR_BLOCK_NODE_PREFIX_MISMAT.desc: Locator whose block_len + node_len does not equal the prefix length, and whose four lengths still sum to <= 128
eStr: locator prefix length must equal block_len + node_len

SRV6_MY_LOCATOR_DEFAULT_LENGTHS_PREFIX_M.desc: Locator with only a /64 prefix, so the block_len 32 and node_len 16 defaults do not cover the prefix
eStr: locator prefix length must equal block_len + node_len

SRV6_MY_SID_SAME_ACTION_SAME_LOCATOR_INV.desc: Invalid: two End SIDs in one locator share an FRR SID context, so FRR keeps only one
eStr: Another SID in this locator already uses the same action

SRV6_MY_SID_SAME_ACTION_EXPLICIT_DEFAULT.desc: Invalid: an explicit decap_vrf 'default' collides with the defaulted one
eStr: Another SID in this locator already uses the same action

SRV6_MY_SID_SAME_ACTION_DIFFERENT_LOCATO.desc: Valid: the same action in two locators with different blocks

SRV6_MY_SID_DIFFERENT_ACTIONS_SAME_LOCAT.desc: Valid: End and End.PSP in one locator have different FRR SID contexts

SRV6_MY_SID_SAME_ACTION_NON_DT_DIFFERENT.desc: Invalid: two End SIDs in one locator collide even with different decap_vrf, since FRR ignores the VRF for non-DT actions
eStr: Another SID in this locator already uses the same action

SRV6_MY_SID_SAME_DT_ACTION_DIFFERENT_VRF.desc: Valid: two uDT46 SIDs in one locator decap into different VRFs, so their FRR SID contexts differ

SRV6_MY_SID_SAME_END_X_SAME_ADJ_INVALID.desc: Invalid: two End.X SIDs in one locator with the same interface and adj share an FRR SID context
eStr: Another SID in this locator already uses the same action

SRV6_MY_SID_SAME_END_X_DIFFERENT_ADJ_VAL.desc: Valid: two End.X SIDs in one locator on the same interface with different adj have different FRR SID contexts

SRV6_END_X_VLAN_MISSING.desc: An End.X SID naming a VLAN that does not exist is refused.

SRV6_END_X_VLAN_4095.desc: An End.X SID on Vlan4095 is refused.
